description: Execute the bound approach, grasp, closure and Lift sequence with the detached grasp-planning robot and open-gripper model. Validate the actual sequence, closure limits, selected-target contact links, environment, peer arm and self-collision. Retain provisional holding evidence after Lift. verify_grasp confirms holding and inherits the confirmed target ID from the bound continuous execution before attachment. GraspGen TCP +Z is prefiltered to the world +X forward / -Z downward sector with a configurable lateral angle limit, default 30 degrees. Grasp Lift follows world +Z for 150 mm. Numerical endpoint orientation and sampled Lift FK checks enforce these constraints before execution.
capability: Execute the prechecked approach/grasp/lift sequence with scheduled closure, then await graph visual verification
